scope: Independent engineering review of R2 evidence_preflight.py and adjacent tests; other implementation read-only.
assessment: New identity, boundary and command-gap diagnostics remain source-review leads. They neither authenticate a source nor approve an inventory or infer a legal outcome.
Raw Unicode character offsets, exact source slices, text/source hashes, page and line receipts are preserved. Dossier mutation was not observed in focused tests or any of 38 independent probes.

Malformed numeric ranges, incorrect quotes and contradictory text/source hash declarations cannot credit command coverage in final reviewed code. Complete disjoint/overlapping coverage suppresses the new command warning.

A target in a multi-order source is bounded before neighboring commands; ambiguous bare headings retain boundary review. Recitals, formulas and post-signature annexes do not acquire semantic completeness approval.
No new external package dependency is introduced. Existing clause-drafts locator code is newly exercised broadly, and consumer dependency receipts need the explicit integration follow-up below.

resolved_review_findings.initial_finding: Contradictory clause.source.sha256 with otherwise identical text path/hash was credited toward complete coverage.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Final _inventory_ranges rejects explicitly contradictory raw hashes, including sha256/local_file_sha256 fallback. Added synthetic regression and independent conflicting_sha256 probe both produce a review lead.

resolved_review_findings.initial_finding: Quoted amendment payload omitted from the inventory was missed after a blank paragraph boundary while the no-blank form warned.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Final quotation handling emits a qualified quoted_command_candidate lead for both layouts. New regression and independent separate_paragraph_quoted_amendment probe pass.

resolved_review_findings.initial_finding: Real-source omission regression could silently exercise zero controls when COMPARISON results were empty.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Final test asserts exactly three controls with the expected instrument-ID set. Final independent 22-test run passes after this assertion and source hydration newline correction.

required_integration_handoff.finding: Packet/apply/completion preflight_dependency_sha256 equality currently names only excavate.py, while the new diagnostics execute jobs/clause-drafts/segment.py for every original.
required_integration_handoff.qualification: This expands a pre-existing dependency closure gap: _extent already used that locator for trailing-number documents. Existing inputs.txt does include segment.py for runner materialization, so missing runtime materialization is not asserted.
required_integration_handoff.action: Pin the exact clause-drafts locator dependency in consumer preparation/apply/completion checks and test changed-dependency refusal before claiming complete integration. Those consumers were outside this reviewer write scope.

remaining_diagnostic_limits: This is a finite lexical screen, not a semantic clause inventory. Must/will wording, title/all-caps heuristics and other OCR failures can escape command coverage.
WHEREAS recitals and post-signature annexes remain outside body-gap detection. Their absence from tasks supplies no legal or inventory approval.

Capitalized reference lines and period-free dated order references may look like generic headings and conservatively trigger boundary review. Duplicate target headings may select the first located document. These are bounded parser ambiguities, not authoritative wrong-order determinations.
Quoted material may now generate review leads even when it is merely a statute/form quotation; continuation sentences are not a complete quotation-state classifier.

validation.skip_reason: Existing native FR source texts not hydrated for three tests.

asserted_invariants: every emitted gap is an exact nonempty raw-source span

initial_environment_failures: Before parent hydration, excavate contract test lacked four example JSONL files, original-identity setup lacked stage19 claim_gate.py, and all 17 batch tests stopped at that missing fixture. These were sparse-checkout absences, not source deletions or demonstrated regressions.
Parent hydrated missing fixtures and final independent reruns above pass. No reviewer hydration or implementation/canonical edit was performed.
